top_signals.title: Japan core inflation in September surges to its highest this year at 2.1%
top_signals.summary: Core inflation, which strips out prices of fresh food, was in line with than the 2.1% forecast by economists polled by Reuters.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Elon Musk invests about $1 billion in Skydance
top_signals.summary: David Ellison's father, billionaire and Oracle co-founder Larry Ellison, has a history with Musk.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Underdog taps zerohash to bring crypto deposits to prediction markets
top_signals.summary: The new funding option, expected to launch later this year, will allow eligible Underdog users to deposit digital assets around the clock.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: LDP presents compromise proposal on Lower House seat cut
top_signals.summary: The LDP hopes to reach a conclusion by the end of this month based on its latest proposal, but it remains to be seen if an agreement will be clinched.
